amendments.reason: V1 freeze CLI omitted the filed-before-affected-data flag. No n51 projection or checker data existed. V2 repeats the same scientific plan and records the intended pre-data attestation.

inputs: SHA-pinned original n51 D4 certificate and original checker receipt
outputs: Projected D4 file, SHA-256, projection and checker transcripts and terminal receipts.

arms.description: Project the SHA-pinned accepted original D4 map by eliminating variable 26.
Rebuild descent and trace relation and check C0-C3 on the projected map.

claims.text: The projected map is an accepted sliced D4 nonmembership certificate only when the independent checker validates C0-C3 and the trace relation.

aa.not_applicable_reason: One deterministic named map and exact algebra, with no timing comparison.

negative.not_applicable_reason: SHA mismatch and malformed certificate are rejection conditions, not statistical controls.

positive.not_applicable_reason: The original n51 D4 map was already independently accepted; this run checks its new slice.

decision_rule.text: Only checker status valid_affine_slice_nonmembership is an accepted sliced D4 seed. A projected file alone has no LFD conclusion. Any refusal or timeout leaves slice seed unknown.
decision_rule.threshold: Checker reports valid_affine_slice_nonmembership, with correct pinned source and plan hashes.

placement.checkpoint_detail: No checkpoints or automatic retries; partial output is not evidence.

inadmissible: Calling a projection an accepted certificate before independent checker acceptance.
Inferring LFD >= 6 from a D4 sliced seed.
Retrying after timeout under this one-attempt protocol.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.

literature.claim: Trace projection and C0-C3 independent check are defined in the affine slice dossier.

primary.definition: Codimension from an independently accepted sliced quotient map; absent on checker failure.
primary.name: checked sliced D4 codimension lower bound

question: Does exact trace projection of the accepted named n51 polynomial01 D4 map pass an independent sliced D4 closure check?

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact named-input replay has no arm-dependent clock inference.

blinding.how: Exact inputs and prior campaign are visible; no population or timing inference.

instance_sampling.rule: One fixed n51 polynomial01 record from the prior certified frontier; no population inference.

seed_derivation.note: Original named input seed, no resampling.

graphs: One-row evidence flow with unknown state explicit.

power.note: Exact named-input verification, no population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Hard 1800-second projection and 3600-second checker limits; not a timing claim.

stopping_rules.rule: One projection and one checker attempt on the fixed named n51 D4 map; stop on checker acceptance, refusal, timeout, or resource failure.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact certificate verification, no performance comparison.

comparisons.threshold: Independent checker accepts C0-C3 and the trace relation.
